title: Creation
author: Madhu Sriwastav
text:
a seed burst
a tiny life twirled forth
soaking in the sun
fed by wet soil
with the playful wind
goat bleats, chomps…
one life ends to sustain another

a brush moves over a pot
smearing art to utility

the hand that paints
the hand that creates
comes together in prayer
humble in heart
for it knows
action sees completion
only
when the creator of all creations
complies!
stanzas: one life ends to sustain another
a brush moves over a pot
when the creator of all creations
